Use clear print or larger writing for the heading and fluent joined handwriting for the body if that improves readability.
Make the heading so decorative that the words cannot be read.

explanation.summary: Handwriting choices can vary with purpose while remaining clear.
explanation.hint: Format should help readers see the text structure.
